title: Job Openings: Total Nonfarm (JOLTS)
reading: Labor demand. Falling openings with low layoffs = cooling without pain.

title: Hires Rate: Total Nonfarm (JOLTS)
reading: Churn. Low hires rate means a 'low hire, low fire' frozen market.

title: Quits Rate: Total Nonfarm (JOLTS)
reading: Worker confidence. Quits fall when workers fear they cannot find a new job.

title: Layoffs and Discharges: Total Nonfarm (JOLTS)
reading: Employer-driven separations. A rise here is the recessionary signal.

title: Unemployment Rate
reading: Headline slack. Sahm rule: +0.5pp from 12-month low of 3mo avg flags recession.

title: All Employees: Total Nonfarm
reading: Payroll jobs. Look at monthly change, not level; ~100k/mo is breakeven.

title: Initial Claims
reading: Highest-frequency layoff gauge. Sustained >300k historically = trouble.

title: Real Gross Domestic Product
reading: Output level. Use the % change series for growth rates.

title: Real GDP: Percent Change from Preceding Period
reading: Headline quarterly growth rate (annualized). Trend ~2%.

title: Industrial Production Index
reading: Monthly goods-sector output. Early read on manufacturing cycles.

title: CPI: All Items (Urban)
reading: Headline inflation. Compute YoY % change; Fed target is ~2% on PCE.

title: CPI: All Items Less Food & Energy
reading: Core CPI. Strips volatile components; what the Fed watches more closely.

title: PCE Price Index Less Food & Energy
reading: Core PCE. The Fed's official 2% target measure.

title: 3-Month Treasury Constant Maturity
reading: Short end. Tracks expected Fed policy over the next quarter.

title: 2-Year Treasury Constant Maturity
reading: Market's view of Fed policy over the next two years.

title: 10-Year Treasury Constant Maturity
reading: Benchmark long rate. Growth + inflation expectations + term premium.

title: 30-Year Treasury Constant Maturity
reading: Long end. Sensitive to fiscal and term-premium concerns.

title: 10-Year Minus 2-Year Treasury Spread
reading: Classic inversion gauge. Negative has preceded every recession since 1970s.

title: 10-Year Minus 3-Month Treasury Spread
reading: NY Fed's preferred recession-probability input.

title: Effective Federal Funds Rate
reading: Actual policy rate. Compare with DGS2 to see market vs Fed.

title: U. of Michigan Consumer Sentiment
reading: Household mood. Weak link to spending, strong link to politics/prices.

title: Housing Starts: Total
reading: Most rate-sensitive sector. Leads the cycle.

title: Advance Retail Sales: Retail Trade and Food Services
reading: Nominal consumer spending. Deflate with CPI for real growth.

title: NBER Recession Indicator
reading: Official recession dating; use for context shading.
